pythonFunction.name: fetch_account_by_name_address
pythonFunction.description:
Identifies the account from the customer's first name, last name and service address (Tier 1
fallback, fuzzy match on the address). Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational
pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    first_name: Customer first name (REQUIRED).
    last_name: Customer last name (REQUIRED).
    address: Service address as the customer says it, street number and street name at least
        (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, found, count, accounts and, on one match, the Identified account summary;
    attempts_remaining on a miss; account_locked true when the online account is locked (offer the unlock flow).
